name: Ablative Skin
flavor_text: A mesh, added on top of the skin, that helps resisting against heat and fire based injury.
effect: Halves heat and fire damage (except lasers). Cannot catch on fire.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Bionic Cardiovascular Enhancements
flavor_text: A cybernetic cardiovascular replacement. Can withstand more strain than the body's natural systems.
effect: Increases MT by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Bionic Extremity
flavor_text: A cybernetic body part to replace a lost one
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Climbing Arm
flavor_text: Cybernetic arms with a strong grip that can lock their fingers in position to prevent all exhaustion from holding on to ledges.
effect: Grants a +15 bonus to climbing tests and tests made to resist being disarmed.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Deadeye
flavor_text: A holographic eye implant that grants many features like magnification and a range finder to assist in marksmanship
effect: Aim actions grant an additional +10 to the following shot. The target can move at any speed and the aim bonus is not lost, as long as it remains visible. The character can only benefit from one Deadeye.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Decentralized Muscle Processors
flavor_text: Muscle memory was taken literally with this enhancement. Reactions are now partially calculated near the acting muscle fibers.
effect: Grants +20 to all reaction tests. Enables the user to parry non-primitive ranged weapons. Feinting against the user is twice as effective.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Jump Joints
flavor_text: Cybernetic loaded joints and leg bones that greatly increase jump height. No world records have been made using a set of these however - not for a lack of effectiveness, they were banned in sports before they were ever used.
effect: Jump and leap distances are doubled. Halves distance for calculation of fall damage when landing in a controlled way.
mods: Aesthetic, Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: L1NC
flavor_text: The Level One Neural Connector, likely the most common implant out there. It's relatively cheap and connects the user to the global AR network. With it the world becomes a vibrant place of color and music.
effect: The user is connected to the global AR network. Most important information is shared through it: Shopping windows, guides, traffic signs, to name a few. People without this implant essentially live in another world, and are generally suspicious within the city. \\ Due to its importance, the L1NC has been optimized to the extreme. It is the safest implant out there, having almost no load on the body. It is also shielded from EMP.
mods: None

name: Lifter Arms
flavor_text: Arm and back implants that improve slow, sustained strength feats like lifting objects
effect: Str for the purpose of determining carry weight, and on tests for slow feats of strength is increased by 40.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Perfect fit

name: Neural Vault
flavor_text: A brain implant that represses all but the most necessary emotions
effect: The character gains the benefits of \emph{Broken}, stacking with the ability. He may never benefit from any positive disposition.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Pain Inhibitors
flavor_text: An implant that suppresses all pain reception, enabling fighting way beyond mortal limits.
effect: The user suffers no pain or related effects. Due to removal of a natural inhibitor, the character suffers D5-2 dmg to a random location and D5 exhaustion at the end of every day he is active, ignoring injury threshold.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Protected Senses
flavor_text: Sensory overload can be a detriment to many professionals, from soldiers to thieves. This augment protects from such occurrences at some loss to the sense's accuracy
effect: Grants +20 to resist overstimulation like blinding, deafening or pain. Using the associated sense suffers a -10.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Quick Replacement Extremity
flavor_text: A cheap cybernetic arm that can quickly be replaced with a new, undamaged one without taking much time getting used to.
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them. Zone HP is reduced to 20%. As long as the interface is not destroyed, an extremity can be replaced in 15 seconds (5 rounds). \\ Note: most mods are applied to the mount point but some may be applied to the limb instead as per GM discretion
cost: 40 to install the interface; cR 20 per limb
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Rayleigh Fibers
flavor_text: An enhancement over the natural nervous system to massively increase reaction speed
effect: Grants +10 to all reaction tests. The character can dodge or parry non-primitive ranged weapons.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Skin-Tight Holoprojector
flavor_text: Technically not just one but a set of holographic projectors, that obscure the user's movements and make it hard to track exactly what someone is doing.
effect: Grants -20 to attacks and parries against the user. The user suffers -20 to any tests made to hide while active. It can be activated as an action. \\ It has no effect when wearing armor or thick clothing.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Aesthetic

name: Subdermal Data Storage
flavor_text: A large data storage implanted within the body. Nearly impossible to detect, great for smuggling data.
effect: The user always has data storage at hand. The connector can be found with a -30 Investigation test - if it is technically possible.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Thermal Vision
flavor_text: An implant that allows interpretation of infrared light as visible light
effect: Allows the user to see IR light like heat sources and IR lasers. This may grant +20 to finding hidden people.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Voice Modulator
flavor_text: Adjustments to the voice box allow a user to reform the vocal cords, allowing for potentially flawless imitation - at least in terms of sound.
effect: Vocal Deceive, Intimidate or Performance tests gain +20.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Bone Casing
flavor_text: Half cybernetic, half bioengineered hardened casing for the human skeleton
effect: Grants 6 armor to the location. Swimming tests suffer a -15 penalty and weight is increased by 10%.
mods: Wrongly fitted; Perfect fit

name: Compound Eyes
flavor_text: Fly-like eyes that, while reducing some detail, give the user a much larger field of view.
effect: Grants the user +30 to tests against being ambushed or surprised. The user's control area increases to 270°. Visual perception when looking for details suffers a -10.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Extradextrous Arm
flavor_text: An arm featuring increased flexibility and improved tactile sense but somewhat lacking in raw strength.
effect: The user gains +10 Dex, -10 Str and +20 to tactile perception using this arm.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Integrated Weaponry

name: Flexible Bone Mesh
flavor_text: An injection that adds some flex to the user's bones, granting better movement but an overall weaker frame.
effect: Grants +20 to most acrobatics checks and all tests to squeeze through small spaces or out of grapples. The user suffers -10 to resist getting knocked down. The zone's HP are halved.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough

name: Gills
flavor_text: Implanted additional gills to provide another source of oxygen.
effect: Allows the character to breathe under water.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Gyro Legs
flavor_text: Flexible legs and dexterous feet with opposable thumbs are installed into the user's lower body.
effect: The character can now stand up in half the time (an action turns into a free action), won't fall over by himself and gains a +20 bonus to resist being knocked over. However he can no longer wear normal shoes.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough

name: High-performance senses
flavor_text: In the animal kingdom heightened senses are frequently the difference between life and death. Generally human brains cannot handle the sudden increase in stimulus that well.
effect: Grants +20 to perception tests using one particular sense. The user suffers -10 to tests resisting overstimulation (like blinding, deafening or pain).
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Metabolism Booster
flavor_text: Efficiently closing wounds always was import to humans. This rare implant can enhance natural healing but is quite inefficient and requires a lot of additional chemical energy.
effect: Once per day, if the character is not already malnourished or starving, the character may take 15 minutes of rest to gain natural healing and restore 2D5 exhaustion. The user will become extremely hungry afterwards and take a -20 penalty to most actions until he gets a meal.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Mucus Gland
flavor_text: An engineered gland producing thick mucus. While it stinks, it is very resistant.
effect: The character gains 3 temporary HP on every zone, which don't contribute to degradation when lost. When they are lost, it takes a minute for them to regenerate. The user suffers the effects of Bane: Terrible Odor and Bane: Ugly.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Oxygen Tanks
flavor_text: Additional organs that save oxygen and reduce the feeling of exhaustion.
effect: The user's exhaustion threshold is doubled.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Pheromone Glands
flavor_text: Airborne pheromones as a means of communication are a staple in the animal kingdom. While humans can't quite use it to communicate, this augment allows subtle manipulation during swaying attempts.
effect: Grants +20 to all friendly social tests - the bonus is +40 instead in enclosed rooms without airflow. If either the target or the user wears vac-sealed armor, the augment has no effect.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Radiation Proofing
flavor_text: An under-skin mesh that blocks many forms of harmful radiation.
effect: Grants +40 to tests to resist radiation poisoning and +30 to tests against getting shocked. The user's augments are immune to EMP.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Reprocessor Stomach
flavor_text: A recycler squeezing the last nutrients from food waste. One of the only cybernetics straining medical toughness.
effect: The speed of starvation is reduced to a quarter.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Shadow Runners
flavor_text: Very springy leg replacements, making it much easier to walk silently.
effect: Sound-related penalties on sneaking tests are halved, at least reduced by 10.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Powerful, Inconspicuous

name: Shielded Nerves
flavor_text: An enhancement to the user's nervous system designed to bear larger loads. While it replaces a large part of the nervous system, it is compatible with any other augment.
effect: Increases RI by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Tenadermis
flavor_text: An engineered gland that creates a thick, tough layer just below the skin.
effect: Grants +15 natural armor. It removes all sense of touch, effectively granting the effects of \emph{Bane: No tactile sense}. Penalties from additional worn armor are doubled.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Toxin Filters
flavor_text: A very large group of various replacements that remove toxic substances from all parts of the body.
effect: The user becomes immune to almost all toxins. This includes the detriments of any chems.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Inconspicuous

name: Vat-grown Body Part
flavor_text: A biological body part grown in a vat, usually grown from the patient's own DNA. Just as good as the original.
effect: A lost or broken body part is restored back to normal. \\% It is possible to grow an exact clone. This takes very long (\sim 4 months) but does not use any MT.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Integrated Weaponry

name: Wound Sealant Foam Gland
flavor_text: An engineered gland that releases blood clotting foam when injured to prevent large amounts of blood loss.
effect: All bleeding is stopped the moment it begins. Chems last twice as long. These effects, as well as half the implant’s load, are inhibited by most common anesthetics.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit
